task: Fix the UPSTREAM_PATTERNS boundary in check_skill_md_portability.py, which misses absolute upstream paths and matches inside longer paths and URLs. Refs #3471.

events.content: Confirmed the defect against the code on main rather than against my own notes. Called count_upstream_refs from a copy of main's module on nine path shapes: four that should count returned 0, five that should not count returned 1.

Traced the cause. PR #3463 fixed a genuine mid-path defect by adding a bare lookbehind to the two templates patterns; the lookbehind also rejects the leading slash of an absolute path. The three legacy patterns were never touched and carry the mirror-image defect.
Replaced all five ad hoc prefixes with one shared _BOUNDARY constant that optionally consumes a leading separator or ./ before applying the lookbehind.
Kept ../ excluded. An existing test asserts it, because a parent-relative path resolves outside the repo root. An earlier draft of the boundary allowed it and that test caught the regression.
Exercised 41 path shapes through the real count_upstream_refs API with zero failures, then added 13 test cases and proved 9 of them fail against the previous regex.
Filed issue #3471 with the reproduction table before opening the PR.
